searchText: EIP-7776: Prevent Block Gas Smuggling https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8918 Alternative to EIP-7623 "increase call data cost"; by instead ignoring calldata zero token discounts and sstore refunds when calculating block gas use (so included txs can't go "over" block gaslimit via reductions) i dont get how sstore refunds have anything to do with block size Is how Xen token miners kill throughput; the refunds allow you to include more activities in the block Have 30M block; get 10M refunds, now can add 10M more; is now again a 30M block when actually its a 40M block of work for the Evm? that's very different than what 7623 does you proposal does not reduce the max block size over the wire It does because it prices all calldata at 16 gas whether zero or non-zero for the block (rather than tx which has a 12 gas discount for zero) So block is capped at the lower non-zero calldata side that's already the case over the wire with snappy encoding 13MB of json though between EL and CL 😛 im just saying your eip is very different than 7623, so i wouldn't call it an alternative ok let me work out how to make it complementary then Realinged 🙂

EIP-7776: Prevent Block Gas Smuggling https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8918

Alternative to EIP-7623 "increase call data cost"; by instead ignoring calldata zero token discounts and sstore refunds when calculating block gas use (so included txs can't go "over" block gaslimit via reductions)

excerpts.author: ben_a_adams
excerpts.content:
It does because it prices all calldata at 16 gas whether zero or non-zero for the block (rather than tx which has a 12 gas discount for zero)

So block is capped at the lower non-zero calldata side
